title: Trono qhepäjjankir chʼamaka
intro: Jumax mä jach'a nayra apnaqäwin pationakapan sayt'atätawa, kawkhantix mä ch'aman apnaqirix taqi jaqinakar diosjamaw uñt'ayasi. Uka apnaqiri jakʼanjja, Diosar taqe chuyma serviriw saytʼatäski, juparojj reinopan jachʼa amtanakapwa katuyatäski. Mayachtʼasisaw mä amtar puripxi ukat amtapxi, jupanakar irpañatak khitatäki uka khithanit iwxtʼanakaparux janiw istʼañ munapkiti. ¿Khitis uka taqe chuyma serviripajj uk amuytʼasmati?
clues: Mä jachʼa reinonwa jakayäta, uka reinojj wali chʼamani jaqen apnaqatäjjänwa, jupajj taqe jaqenakat sipansa Diosaw sasaw säna.
Uka apnaqirin atinisiñjam ministropjamaw irnaqtʼawayta, taqe kuntï lurañ munapkäna ukat taqe kuntï lurapkäna ukanak phoqayäta.
Kunawsatix Allah-an mä khithanitapax uraqisar chiqar jawsayas purinkäna ukhax apnaqirijampix janiw ist’añ munapkti.
Mä jachʼa nina naktayañajataki ukat laqʼat ladrillonak wakichtʼañajatakiw mayïna, ukhamat mä jachʼa uta lurañataki.
Jilïrijajj mä jachʼa uta saytʼayañ munäna, ukhamat alajjpachar puriñapataki.
Qhiparusti, apnaqirijampi, ejercitonakajampi, nayampixa, umampi ch’allt’ata, lamar quta manqharuwa umamp chhaqhayasipxta.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
